description: Owner answer 1 of 2026-10-22 ("프로젝트 목록 스냅샷으로 채점"): the Jira world the read scorers resolve jira.release args against (data, not rules). Provenance: the projects and the OP26 versions are the owner-approved read-only live probe of 2026-10-15 as recorded in packages/core/src/application/work-chat/jira-release.test.ts ('live names (owner-approved read-only probe, 2026-10-15)'): project OP26 '차란차 플랫폼 운영 2026', OP25 '차란차 플랫폼 운영 2025', APPOP '차란차 플랫폼 APP운영', COP26 '코브랜드 운영 2026'; OP26 versions 16591 '배포일_20261020(화)', 16555 '배포일_20261015(목)' (the version id of the gold release-report links a8-05/a8-06/a8-25) and 16104 '비정기 배포'. Added from the owner DM smoke 2026-10-22 (Quoky's own ambiguous-project reply, which listed the visible projects matching "차란차 운영"): OP21 '차란차 플랫폼 운영 2021' and OP24 '차란차 플랫폼 운영 2024' (names and keys only; their versions were not read). The snapshot is optimistic on version-page completeness: OP21 and OP24 carry no versions here, while live they hold full first version pages (a partial page leaves the release narrowing unproven, the path the 2026-10-22 smoke took); the unit and acceptance tests cover that path, not this snapshot. The site host is the host of those gold links. Only OP26's versions were probed: the other projects carry no versions here. Release items are not part of the snapshot (every item query answers an empty list); a release name that no visible version carries is Jira's NOT_FOUND. The identity is a placeholder for the owner's Jira account (scope mine). Assumptions (CA review W4), not probed facts: the release statuses (released / unreleased) are not in the cited fixture and are assumed here; the 6-project listing is assumed complete (the probe and the smoke recorded these projects, not proof that no other project is visible), and the versions of OP21, OP24, OP25, APPOP and COP26 are assumed empty.
